summary: BrainsWay filed a Form 6-K announcing a $500,000 minority-stake investment in Sound Minds Behavioral (CM Counsel Management LLC), structured as a preferred, annually compounding security. No stake percentage, price per share, or premium is stated; the investment is strategic, not a listed deal. There is no board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory clock. The transaction is a routine equity investment, not a special-situation acquisition, tender, or restructuring. As a foreign private issuer report, it updates existing shelf registrations. No risk-arb angle exists.
